evidence: Adds Testnet 5 consensus parameters in src/kernel/chainparams.cpp, modifying difficulty rules and activating BIP 54 from block 1.
rationale: Testnet 5 introduces a new network configuration to resolve recurring testnet difficulty manipulation and enable testing of BIP 54 rules. As noted in the description, earlier testnets suffer from block storms due to the 20-minute minimum-difficulty exception, and BIP 95 provides a clean network enforcing consensus cleanup from genesis.
